calculation.description: For each tradable asset, compute 20-day cumulative close return multiplied by 10-day directional efficiency (sum of signed daily returns divided by sum of absolute daily returns), then cross-sectionally residualize this score against the contemporaneous five-day return. The residual is the observable signal; higher values indicate cleaner, persistent momentum not explained by the short-term five-day return exposure.

regime_notes.interpretation: Positive daily IC in all three regimes; small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative sizing and deterministic library-correlation audit. Longer 5- and 10-day horizons were stronger than the admission horizon.

validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation between signal at t and forward close return over the stated horizon, with at least 8 valid instruments. Data visible through 2027-03-24 only.
